integrity: Exact PPP/Mecke and renewal arguments establish all infinite statements. An auxiliary 17-assertion numerical check is corroborative only. Historical priority remains qualified.
scientific_limitations: The proof concerns the limiting exponential-mark Poisson envelope only. Finite-population path convergence, convergence of actual discrete sweep counts, nonexponential mark laws, and quantitative finite-size approximation are not established. Broader envelope theory might subsume portions of the formulas.
title: Exact aging and non-Poisson sweep times in an exponential-mark envelope
